materials.passage: My name is Leo. I live near a small park. On weekdays, I walk to work, and the walk takes fifteen minutes. On Saturdays, I help in a community garden. I usually arrive at nine in the morning. We grow tomatoes and beans, but I do not take any vegetables home. The garden gives them to a local food bank. I enjoy the work because I meet my neighbours there. When it rains, we work in a small greenhouse instead of outside.

materials.title: 我的英语学习习惯
instructions: 先独立写，不看后面的示例。建议先写5至7个简单句，说明时间、地点和一个原因。
50至80词是练习建议，超出或不足时保留原稿，不自动判错或换算雅思分。
保存第一稿，按自查问题改一处，再保存修改稿。

materials.prompt: Write 50–80 words about when and where you study English. Explain one reason for your routine.
selfCheck: 我写清楚了什么时候、在哪里学习英语。
我解释了一个原因，读者能看懂这个原因与安排的关系。
我检查了句首大写、句末标点，以及常见词的拼写。
我能指出修改稿中一处具体改动，并解释为什么修改。
materials.example: I study English after work. I usually start at seven and study for forty minutes. First, I review a few words. Then I read a short text and write three sentences. I like studying at home because it is quiet. On busy days, I do a shorter lesson. This helps me keep learning every week.

materials.title: 下班或放学以后
instructions: 先看问题，准备30秒，然后连续回答两个问题并录音；建议合计40至60秒。
可以用简单句；忘词时尝试换一种说法，不为凑时长背示例。
回听原录音，写下一个想改进的地方。隔天再录一次，保留两份录音。
这是基础短答，不是完整口语模考；时长和转写不换算发音或雅思口语分。
